```{r}
# time-dependent interventions

library(tidyverse)
library(deSolve)

# ---- 0. 設定 ----
# 時間と計算方法の設定
set_control <- function(time_begin = 0, time_end, increment = 0.1,
                        method = "rk4") {
  time <- seq(time_begin, time_end, by = increment)
  list(
    time_begin = time_begin, time_end = time_end,
    increment = increment, time = time, method = method
  )
}

# 人口の設定
set_population <- function(N0 = 1, I0 = 10e-6,
                           contact_matrix = NULL, susceptibility = NULL) {
  dimens <- length(N0)
  if (is.null(names(N0))) {
    if (dimens == 1) {
      names(N0) <- "all"
    } else {
      names(N0) <- as.character(seq(1:dimens))
    }
  }
  if (is.null(susceptibility)) {
    susceptibility <- rep(1, time = dimens)
  }
  if (is.null(contact_matrix)) {
    contact_matrix <- matrix(N0, nrow = dimens, ncol = dimens)
  }

  contact_matrix <- susceptibility * contact_matrix
  eigen <- max(Re(eigen(contact_matrix)$values))
  contact_matrix <- contact_matrix / eigen
  Zeros <- rep(0, time = dimens)

  initial_conditions <- I0

  list(
    contact_matrix = contact_matrix,
    demography_vector = N0,
    initial_conditions = initial_conditions,
    susceptibility = susceptibility,
    dimens = dimens
  )
}

# 疫学パラメータの設定
set_parms <- function(compartment, r0 = 2.5,
                      gamma = 1 / 4.8, epsilon = 1 / 5) {
  beta0 <- gamma * r0

  if (compartment == "SIR") {
    list(
      compartment = compartment,
      beta0 = beta0, gamma = gamma
    )
  } else if (compartment == "SEIR") {
    list(
      compartment = compartment,
      beta0 = beta0, gamma = gamma, epsilon = epsilon
    )
  }
}

# 介入の設定
set_intervention <- function(time_begin = control$time_begin,
                             time_end = control$time_end,
                             reduction = 0) {
  list(time_begin = time_begin, time_end = time_end, reduction = reduction)
}

# 時間依存の設定
set_time_dependence <- function(x = NULL, beta = NULL) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
      Xt <- NULL
    } else {
      Xt <- x
    }
    if (is.null(beta)) {
      beta_t <- NULL
    } else {
      beta_t <- beta
    }
    list(Xt = Xt, beta_t = beta_t)
}

mod_X <- function(time_begin = control$time_begin, time_end = control$time_end, reduction = 0, reduction_begin = 0) {
  times_begin <- as.integer((time_begin - control$time_begin) / control$increment) + 1L
  times_end <- as.integer((time_end - control$time_begin) / control$increment) + 1L
  time_dependence <- rep(1.0, length(control$time))
  adjustment_speed <- -log((1 - reduction) / (1 - reduction_begin)) / (time_end - time_begin)
  time_dependence[(times_begin + 1L):times_end] <-
    time_dependence * (1 - reduction_begin) * exp(-adjustment_speed * (
      control$time[(times_begin + 1L):times_end] - time_begin
    ))
  time_dependence
}

mod_beta <- function() {
  time_dependence <- 1 - 0.3 * sin(control$time * control$increment / 2)
  time_dependence
}

# ファクターXの設定
set_input <- function(population, intervention, time_dependence, control) {
  set_reduction_list <- function(intervention, control_time_begin, increment, time, dimens) {
    with(intervention, {
      times_begin <- as.integer((time_begin - control_time_begin) / increment) + 1L
      times_end <- as.integer((time_end - control_time_begin) / increment) + 1L
      x <- matrix(0, nrow = dimens, ncol = length(time))
      x[, (times_begin + 1L):times_end] <- reduction
      x
    })
  }

  if (is.null(intervention)) {
    reduction_combined <- matrix(0, nrow = population$dimens, ncol = length(control$time))
  } else {
    reduction_list <- map(intervention, \(x) set_reduction_list(
      x, control$time_begin, control$increment, control$time, population$dimens
    ))
    reduction_combined <- reduce(reduction_list, `+`)
  }
  Ones <- matrix(1, nrow = length(control$time), ncol = population$dimens)
  X <- Ones - t(reduction_combined)
  if (!is.null(time_dependence) & !is.null(time_dependence$Xt)) {
    X <- X * time_dependence$Xt
  }
  if (!is.null(time_dependence) & !is.null(time_dependence$beta_t)) {
    X <- X * time_dependence$beta_t
  }
  if (phase == "0") {
    if (!is.null(time_dependence$Xt)) {plot(time_dependence$Xt)}
  }
    colnames(X) <- names(population$demography_vector)
  X
}

# SIRモデルの解を求める
model_sir <- function(scenario = "default", aggr = FALSE) {
  func_sir <- function(t, y, parms, input_list, population) {
    with(c(parms, population), {
      S <- y[1:dimens]
      I <- y[(dimens + 1):(2L * dimens)]
      R <- y[(2L * dimens + 1):(3L * dimens)]

      beta <- beta0 * map_vec(input_list, \(f) f(t))
      J <- contact_matrix %*% I
      New <- beta * (S / demography_vector) * J

      dS <- -New
      dI <- New - gamma * I
      dR <- gamma * I

      list(c(dS, dI, dR))
    })
  }

  Zeros <- rep(0, time = population$dimens)
  population$initial_conditions <- c(
    S = population$demography_vector - population$initial_conditions,
    I = population$initial_conditions,
    R = Zeros
  )
  X <- set_input(population, intervention, time_dependence, control)
  input_list <- map(
    names(population$demography_vector),
    \(name) approxfun(control$time, X[, name], rule = 2)
  )

  out <- ode(
    y = population$initial_conditions,
    times = control$time,
    func = func_sir,
    parms = parms,
    method = control$method,
    input_list = input_list,
    population = population
  )

  S <- out[, 2:(population$dimens + 1)]
  I <- out[, (population$dimens + 2):(2L * population$dimens + 1)]
  R <- out[, (2L * population$dimens + 2):(3L * population$dimens + 1)]

  beta <- parms$beta0 * t(X)
  J <- population$contact_matrix %*% t(I)
  S_N <- t(S) / population$demography_vector
  New <- t((beta * S_N) * J)
  
  out_df <- cbind(out[, 1], S, I, R, New)
  colnames(out_df) <- c(
    "time",
    str_c("S_", names(population$demography_vector)),
    str_c("I_", names(population$demography_vector)),
    str_c("R_", names(population$demography_vector)),
    str_c("New_", names(population$demography_vector))
  )
  out_df <- as_tibble(out_df) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -time, names_to = "names", values_to = "value") |>
    separate(col = names, into = c("compartment", "demography_group"), sep = "_") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = compartment, values_from = value) |>
    mutate(scenario = scenario)
  if (aggr == TRUE) {
    out_df <- out_df |>
      group_by(time) |>
      summarize(S = sum(S), I = sum(I), R = sum(R), New = sum(New)) |>
      mutate(scenario = scenario)
  }
  out_df
}

# SEIRモデルの解を求める
model_seir <- function(scenario = "default", aggr = FALSE) {
  func_seir <- function(t, y, parms, input_list, population) {
    with(c(parms, population), {
      S <- y[1:dimens]
      E <- y[(dimens + 1):(2L * dimens)]
      I <- y[(2L * dimens + 1):(3L * dimens)]
      R <- y[(3L * dimens + 1):(4L * dimens)]

      beta <- beta0 * map_vec(input_list, \(f) f(t))
      J <- contact_matrix %*% I
      New <- beta * (S / demography_vector) * J

      dS <- -New
      dE <- New - epsilon * E
      dI <- epsilon * E - gamma * I
      dR <- gamma * I

      list(c(dS, dE, dI, dR))
    })
  }

  Zeros <- rep(0, time = population$dimens)
  population$initial_conditions <- c(
    S = population$demography_vector - population$initial_conditions,
    E = Zeros,
    I = population$initial_conditions,
    R = Zeros
  )
  X <- set_input(population, intervention, time_dependence, control)
  input_list <- map(
    names(population$demography_vector),
    \(name) approxfun(control$time, X[, name], rule = 2)
  )

  out <- ode(
    y = population$initial_conditions,
    times = control$time,
    func = func_seir,
    parms = parms,
    method = control$method,
    input_list = input_list,
    population = population
  )

  S <- out[, 2:(population$dimens + 1)]
  E <- out[, (population$dimens + 2):(2L * population$dimens + 1)]
  I <- out[, (2L * population$dimens + 2):(3L * population$dimens + 1)]
  R <- out[, (3L * population$dimens + 2):(4L * population$dimens + 1)]

  beta <- parms$beta0 * t(X)
  J <- population$contact_matrix %*% t(I)
  S_N <- t(S) / population$demography_vector
  New <- t((beta * S_N) * J)

  out_df <- cbind(out[, 1], S, E, I, R, New)
  colnames(out_df) <- c(
    "time",
    str_c("S_", names(population$demography_vector)),
    str_c("E_", names(population$demography_vector)),
    str_c("I_", names(population$demography_vector)),
    str_c("R_", names(population$demography_vector)),
    str_c("New_", names(population$demography_vector))
  )
  out_df <- as_tibble(out_df) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -time, names_to = "names", values_to = "value") |>
    separate(col = names, into = c("compartment", "demography_group"), sep = "_") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = compartment, values_from = value) |>
    mutate(scenario = scenario)
  if (aggr == TRUE) {
    out_df <- out_df |>
      group_by(time) |>
      summarize(S = sum(S), E = sum(E), I = sum(I), R = sum(R), New = sum(New)) |>
      mutate(scenario = scenario)
  }
  out_df
}

# 新規感染者数のグラフ
plot_New <- function(data, variable, title = "") {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = New, colour = scenario)) +
    labs(
      title = title, x = "流行時刻（日）", y = "新規感染者数（人/日）",
      colour = ""
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.7))
}

# 感染者数のグラフ
plot_I <- function(data, variable, title = "") {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = I, colour = scenario)) +
    labs(
      title = title, x = "流行時刻（日）", y = "感染者数（人）",
      colour = ""
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.7))
}
```

# 図2 即時削減による新規感染者数の推移

「接触が瞬時に8割削減される場合には、新規感染者数は開始の当日に新規感染者数100人の目標を達成する。7割削減の場合には、接触削減から8日目に達成する。」

図2 即時削減による新規感染者数の推移

```{r}
# 新規感染者数が100人を切る日付を探す
find_timex <- function(x, time, time_begin, min) {
  time[(time <= time_begin) | (x >= min)] <- 0
  timex <- time[time > 0]
  return(paste("削減開始から「", timex[1] - time_begin, "日」で、新規感染者数が100人を切る。"))
}

phase <- "1"
# "0" exploratory
# "1" release

# ---- 4. モデルD ----
# 4月9日資料の別計算
N0_jp <- c(c = 15758424, a = 76499828, e = 35185241)
N_all <- sum(N0_jp)
I0_jp <- c(0, 1, 0)

alpha_c <- 0.009
alpha_a <- 0.630
alpha_e <- 1 - alpha_c - alpha_a
susceptibility <- c(alpha_c, alpha_a, alpha_e) / N0_jp

control <- set_control(time_begin = 0, time_end = 90)
population <- set_population(N0_jp, I0_jp, susceptibility = susceptibility)
parms <- set_parms(compartment = "SIR")

h_line <- rep(100, length(control$time))
h_line_I <- list(
  time = control$time,
  I = h_line,
  scenario = rep("100人", time = length(control$time))
)
h_line_New <- list(
  time = control$time,
  New = h_line,
  scenario = rep("100人", time = length(control$time))
)

# 図2
time_dependence <- set_time_dependence(x = NULL)

## シナリオ10
intervention <- list(set_intervention(time_begin = 22, reduction = 0.8))
result_10 <- model_sir(scenario = "8割削減", aggr = TRUE)
find_timex(result_10$New, result_10$time, intervention[[1]]$time_begin, 100)

## シナリオ11
intervention <- list(set_intervention(time_begin = 22, reduction = 0.7))
result_11 <- model_sir(scenario = "7割削減", aggr = TRUE)
find_timex(result_11$New, result_11$time, intervention[[1]]$time_begin, 100)

## 感染者数のグラフ
if (phase == "0") {
  rbind(result_10, result_11) |>
  select(time, I, scenario) |>
  rbind(h_line_I) |>
  plot_I(title = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), breaks = seq(0, 90, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1200), breaks = seq(0, 1200, 100)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    limits = c("8割削減", "7割削減"),
    values = c("blue", "grey")
  )
}

## 新規感染者数のグラフ
rbind(result_10, result_11) |>
  select(time, New, scenario) |>
  rbind(h_line_New) |>
  plot_New(title = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), breaks = seq(0, 90, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 700), breaks = seq(0, 700, 100)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    limits = c("8割削減", "7割削減"),
    values = c("blue", "grey")
  )
```

# 図3 削減期間の比較（7日間と14日間）

「新規感染者数が100人を切るのは7日間で8割削減の場合は10日目、14日間で8割削減の場合は、20日目であり、10日の開きがある。」

図3　削減期間の比較（7日間と14日間）

```{r}
# 図3
## シナリオ12
time_dependence <- set_time_dependence(
  x = mod_X(time_begin = 22, time_end = 29, reduction = 0.8)
)
intervention <- list(set_intervention(time_begin = 29, reduction = 0.8))
result_12 <- model_sir(scenario = "7日間で8割削減）", aggr = TRUE)
find_timex(result_12$New, result_12$time, 22, 100)

## シナリオ13
time_dependence <- set_time_dependence(
  x = mod_X(time_begin = 22, time_end = 36, reduction = 0.8)
)
intervention <- list(set_intervention(time_begin = 36, reduction = 0.8))
result_13 <- model_sir(scenario = "14日間で8割削減", aggr = TRUE)
find_timex(result_13$New, result_13$time, 22, 100)

## 感染者数のグラフ
if (phase == "0") {
  rbind(result_12, result_13) |>
  select(time, I, scenario) |>
  rbind(h_line_I) |>
  plot_I(title = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), breaks = seq(0, 90, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3000), breaks = seq(0, 3000, 500)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    limits = c("7日間で8割削減", "14日間で8割削減"),
    values = c("blue", "grey")
  )
}

## 新規感染者数のグラフ
rbind(result_12, result_13) |>
  select(time, New, scenario) |>
  rbind(h_line_New) |>
  plot_New(title = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), breaks = seq(0, 90, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 800), breaks = seq(0, 800, 100)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    limits = c("7日間で8割削減", "14日間で8割削減"),
    values = c("blue", "grey")
  )
```

# 図4 即時4割削減した後、漸次的に8割削減する場合　

「新規感染者数は接触削減開始とともに瞬時に4割低下することになる。その後に100人を切るのは、7日間で8割削減の場合は6日目、14日間の場合は12日目と、違いは6日になる。」

図4　即時4割削減した後、漸次的に8割削減する場合

```{r}
# 図4
## シナリオ14
time_dependence <- set_time_dependence(
  x = mod_X(time_begin = 22, time_end = 29, reduction = 0.8, reduction_begin = 0.4)
)
intervention <- list(set_intervention(time_begin = 29, reduction = 0.8))
result_14 <- model_sir(scenario = "瞬時に4割削減、7日間で8割削減", aggr = TRUE)
find_timex(result_14$New, result_14$time, 22, 100)

## シナリオ15
time_dependence <- set_time_dependence(
  x = mod_X(time_begin = 22, time_end = 36, reduction = 0.8, reduction_begin = 0.4)
)
intervention <- list(set_intervention(time_begin = 36, reduction = 0.8))
result_15 <- model_sir(scenario = "瞬時に4割削減、14日間で8割削減", aggr = TRUE)
find_timex(result_15$New, result_15$time, 22, 100)

## 感染者数のグラフ
if (phase == "0") {
  rbind(result_14, result_15) |>
  select(time, I, scenario) |>
  rbind(h_line_I) |>
  plot_I(title = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), breaks = seq(0, 90, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1400), breaks = seq(0, 1400, 200)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    limits = c("瞬時に4割削減、7日間で8割削減", "瞬時に4割削減、14日間で8割削減"),
    values = c("blue", "grey")
  )
}

## 新規感染者数のグラフ
rbind(result_14, result_15) |>
  select(time, New, scenario) |>
  rbind(h_line_New) |>
  plot_New(title = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), breaks = seq(0, 90, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 700), breaks = seq(0, 700, 100)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    limits = c("瞬時に4割削減、7日間で8割削減", "瞬時に4割削減、14日間で8割削減"),
    values = c("blue", "grey")
  )
```
